Located in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], '''Madam Vansitt's Charm Academy''' was founded as an establishment where [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] were taught, beyond the courtly arts of dance, song, and conversation, the dark arts of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] with its finer arts of bribery and [[Politics/Legends|political]] blackmail and [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]—using poisons and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], as opposed to the extremes of mechanized battle combat with its use of crude weapons, which was avoided: subtler, less brutal means were needed for women who would be traversing the galaxy and intermingling with a plethora of alien beings in its vast web of political circles. [[Pala Kwi'teksa]], a former slave of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], was a student of the Charm Academy, and Madam [[Vansitt]] esteemed the young girl to be smart and cunning. She knew Pala would make a superb spy.
